judgements.justification: Neither chair cited an assessment outside the record; A's chair paraphrased its own reviewers and B's followed its unanimous reviews.
Both committees judged the paper as a method contribution on novelty and comparisons; B's doubts about VQG's value were a side remark, not a standard it applied that A did not.
B's below-threshold scores rested on limited novelty over DH-VQG and missing comparisons, which are central to the contribution, not peripheral points.
